reviews.author: Mike Rapoport
reviews.summary: The patch was ACKed without any objections or suggestions for changes.
reviews.raw_body:
On Sun, 02 Aug 2026 20:52:33 +0100, Kiryl Shutsemau <kirill@shutemov.name> wrote:
> The khugepaged selftest is about to gain mTHP collapse coverage, which
> needs to verify that a VA range is backed by a folio of a given order.
> split_huge_page_test.c already has the building block for that:
> is_backed_by_folio() classifies the folio backing a page via
> /proc/kpageflags compound head/tail flags.
> 
> Move it into vm_util so other tests can use it. No functional change.
> 
> [...]

Acked-by: Mike Rapoport (Microsoft) <rppt@kernel.org>

-- 
Sincerely yours,
Mike.

2026-08-03.patch_summary: This patch moves the is_backed_by_folio() function from split_huge_page_test.c to vm_util.c, making it available for use in other tests. The function checks if a VA range is backed by a folio of a given order by examining /proc/kpageflags compound head/tail flags. This change does not introduce any functional changes.
